recognize_zh: 左下為一個小型淋巴球，核深染圓形、周圍一圈深藍色細胞質（反應性、偏漿細胞樣）；右上為較大的淋巴球，核偏心、細胞質較豐富淡染，是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）；但本圖解析度下嗜天青顆粒不易看清。
features: Bottom-left: small lymphocyte with dense round nucleus and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm (reactive/plasmacytoid)
Top-right: larger lymphocyte with eccentric oval nucleus and more abundant pale cytoplasm, consistent with a large granular lymphocyte
Azurophilic granules in the larger lymphocyte not clearly resolved at this magnification
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
Numerous platelets, including occasional clumps and a large platelet
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two lymphocytes against a background of normocytic red cells and adequate platelets with occasional clumps. The lower-left cell is a small lymphocyte with a dense round nucleus and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, consistent with a reactive, plasmacytoid lymphocyte. The upper-right cell is larger with an eccentric nucleus and more abundant pale cytoplasm, consistent with a large granular lymphocyte, although cytoplasmic azurophilic granules are not well resolved at this magnification. These findings illustrate normal lymphocyte morphologic variants.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have clock-face chromatin, a distinct perinuclear hof, and more abundant cytoplasm than the plasmacytoid lymphocyte here.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin, and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm.
T-LGL leukemia requires a sustained LGL count above 2 ×10^9/L with clonal TCR rearrangement, not an isolated LGL.
